item.title: Federal troop deployments to US cities cost taxpayers $496M and counting
item.description: The Congressional Budget Office released this estimate after a request from Sen. Jeff Merkley.

item.title: Tesla made smallest annual profit since the pandemic, plans to spend big on robotaxis and robots
item.description: It was the second year in a row with a steep drop in profit.

item.title: Gerber recalls arrowroot biscuits that might contain pieces of plastic or paper
item.description: No illness or injuries have been reported.

item.title: Mayors warn that Trump’s hardline immigration tactics could dent trust in law enforcement
item.description: Many mayors face pressure to remove federal agents.

item.title: EPA plan would begin rolling back ‘good neighbor’ rule on downwind pollution from smokestacks
item.description: The affected states are Alabama, Arizona, Kentucky, Minnesota, Mississippi, Nevada, New Mexico and Tennessee.

item.title: Chinese national who exposed human rights abuses in his homeland is granted asylum to remain in US
item.description: Guan arrived in the U.S. illegally in 2021 and has been in custody since August.

item.title: TikTok star Shirley Raines, known for bringing meals and respect to people on LA’s Skid Row, dies at 58
item.description: Raines began working with homeless communities in 2017.

item.title: Downingtown East boys stay unbeaten; girls upset Rustin
item.description: There was one expected win, and another that was a pleasant surprise. But for both the boys and girls’ swim teams at Downingtown East, Wednesday’s outing against West Chester Rustin was a chance to continue building toward the post-regular season events that matter the most.

item.title: Wrestling: Cranky Sun Valley takes down Oxford for Ches-Mont American crown
item.description: On a night that started with Sarah McLachlan being played while Sun Valley warmed up and ended with fans chanting “start your tractors” toward the Oxford bench, there was no love lost.

item.title: OPINION: Enough with the ‘CEO’ jabs at Eagles coach Nick Sirianni
item.description: The term “CEO head coach,” which is a head coach who doesn’t call plays on either side of the ball, has often been used as a backhanded slight to marginalize coaches’ accomplishments. Exhibit A: Nick Sirianni.
